section.title: Rules
section.description: Rules Check applies to this World's entries and timeline. All statuses are shown — auto-include evaluates active rules only.
section.structuralNote: Each rule carries a structural constraint — module presence/absence, required fields, observer counts — not narrative quality.
section.emptyDescription: Add a structural rule so Check can evaluate this World's entries and timeline.
section.truncated: Showing the first 500 rules by name. Remaining rules are not displayed.
section.errorDescription: Could not load rules for this World.
section.deactivateHelp: Stops Check from auto-including this rule. The rule stays in the list.

form.title: Add rule

module_presence.label: Require a module
module_presence.help: Matching entries must carry this module key.

module_absence.label: Forbid a module
module_absence.help: Matching entries must not carry this module key.

required_field.label: Require a field
required_field.help: Matching entries must have this field populated.

observer_cardinality.label: Limit observers
observer_cardinality.help: Matching events must have an observer count in range.

form.nameHelp: A stable name you will recognize in the list.
form.statementHelp: Check does not read this. The constraint is the fields below.

entry.label: Entry-level field
entry.help: Applies to one of the closed entry-level fields.

module-row.label: Module row
module-row.help: Applies to a free-form field on a row of this module.

form.statusHelp: Active rules are auto-included in Check; draft rules are saved but not auto-included.
form.severityHelp: Not set — Check evaluates the rule as warning.
form.targetTypesHelp: None selected → all entry types in check scope.
form.targetTypesDisabledHelp: Not available for Limit observers — events carry no entry type.
form.genericError: Could not add the rule. Try again.
form.genericUpdateError: Could not save the rule. Try again.
form.notFoundError: This rule could not be found. It may have been removed.

errors.operandRequired: Choose an operand form: entry-level field or module row.
errors.moduleFieldReserved: Entry-level field values cannot be combined with a module row.
errors.minRequired: At least one bound is required.
errors.targetTypesConflict: Target entry types cannot be combined with an observer-count constraint.
